rewrite.hint: Node keeps each evaluated module under its resolved filename. Ask what has to happen to that entry.
rewrite.explanation: require caches a module's exports under its resolved path, so a second require hands back the identical object; deleting that entry makes the next require re-run the file — two requires returned the same value, and the one after the delete returned a new one.
